question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the given group of words.

a wooden frame for holding an artist's work while it is being painted or drawn
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"easel"** means a wooden frame for holding an artist's work while it is being painted or drawn. (चित्रफलक)

 
 
• **Example: **The artist set up his ***easel ***in the park to paint the beautiful landscape.
 
• **Example: **She placed her canvas on the ***easel ***and began to paint a portrait.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct option for 'a wooden frame for holding an artist's work while it is being painted or drawn' is called **'easel'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lectern** (लेकटर्न): A tall stand with a sloping top to hold a book or notes, typically used by a speaker.

 
 
• **Example:** The professor stood behind the** *lectern*** to deliver his lecture.
 
 
 
• **Platform** (मंच): A raised level surface on which people or things can stand.
 
 
• **Example: **The politician addressed the crowd from the ***platform.***
 
 
 
• **Podium** (मंच): A small platform on which a person may stand to be seen by an audience, as when making a speech or conducting an orchestra.
 
 
• **Example:** The conductor stood on the*** podium ***to lead the orchestra.
